steps.name: encamp
steps.probe: (async()=>{const c=document.getElementById('screen');for(let n=0;n<200;n++){window.E.pic.display.present();const data=c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,320,200).data;const snapshot=c.toDataURL('image/png'),hash=[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data))].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');if(hash==='5272a6bf732daaad8c3aaa78ddcd07ad64e706955c2f5cfc4588bd02fbe94c5b'){window.__integrateMatchedShot=snapshot;return {pass:true,naturalAnimationFrame:true,waits:n};}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40));}throw Error('reference camp animation phase did not occur');})()
